meta.title: Firmware Engineer
meta.tagline: Write the low-level software that brings hardware to life.
meta.description: Firmware engineers develop the software layer closest to hardware — device drivers, bootloaders, real-time operating systems and hardware abstraction layers. They optimize for performance, memory and power constraints.
